author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:

After removing the shells and soaking the peas, we grind them into a smooth paste. After settling, it separates into three layers with different textures: pea starch, floating powder, and water. The middle layer, the floating powder, is the key ingredient for making the crispy layers.
Making these crispy layers looks simple, but getting the right consistency of the floating powder took me more than twenty attempts before I finally succeeded. The result is a thin and crispy layer with a rich pea aroma.
The white pea starch is turned into soft pea jelly. While everything is still warm, the crispy layers and jelly layers are stacked together one by one. After cooling, it becomes Nanjian Pea Jelly with Crispy Layers.
The texture is amazing: the crispy layers bring a fragrant, chewy bite, while the pea jelly is soft, smooth, and refreshing.
